Hero_Desc_Lion:
A werebeast who is active as the hero 'Sphinx.'
She wields a mighty hammer with incredible strength, but she also uses that strength to work part-time as a warehouse loader to make a living.
She is very worried about Tig, who refuses to grow up, and Diana, who is having a hard time because of Tig.
Album_Like_Lion: Hammer, judgment, battle of strength, Chief Diana
Album_Lion1: Lion may be young, but she's a very polite werebeast. Whenever someone tries to tease or attack me, she appears in a flash and declares them guilty. Erpin, who's had a taste of Lion's hammer, seems to creep around her now.
Album_Lion2: Since joining the Order, Lion seems to be traveling around not only Monatium but also all over Elias to judge villains. But she hasn't quit working part-time at night as a warehouse loader so I asked her why, and she gave an exemplary answer that she was responsible for her own life.
Album_Lion3: Like her hero name, Sphinx, Lion seems to like to pose riddles. Once I caught Lion and Rim engaged in an intense conversation, but listening closely, I realized that they were only talking about themselves, and it was a wonder how their conversation even continued. The grand confrontation of nonsensical riddles and dad jokes left my head spinning.
Album_Lion4: Lion's strength is staggering. When I first saw Lion judge a villain in person, I was speechless with amazement. It made me realize once again that Lion was indeed a lion werebeast.
Album_Lion5: Lion said she and Tig fought a lot when she lived in the Werebeast Village. Her fists shook whenever she saw Tig being disrespectful to Chief Diana and she couldn't stand it... There is probably no other werebeast who thinks of Diana as highly as Lion does.
Album_Lion6: Suddenly curious where the hammer came from, I asked Lion and she replied that it fell out of the sky during an earthquake. I thought she was joking at first, but I could only nod at her completely serious face. Could it be true...?
Album_Lion7: Lion seems to be working hard to keep order and peace without resting properly. Seeing her asleep in the corner of the Order building, hugging her hammer tightly, was both cute and sad in a strange way. I covered her with a blanket so she wouldn't be cold.
LoveHero_Lion: Master, what would you like your hero name to be?
LoveHeroCancel_Lion: ... Heroes are supposed to be lonely... No, I'm not angry.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Hate1: After hesitating for a while, Lion politely asked if she could have something else. She wanted to eat something different from usual at the Banquet Hall.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Hate2: She was wary of what she called a dangerous drink that would impair her judgment as a hero. She could become like Tig if she drank it, or so she claimed.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like1: After excusing herself for a moment, she began to devour the meat. She polished the plate clean, making the cleanup afterward a simple task.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like2: She asked me several times if it was really okay to give her such fine food for free. Her voice trembled when she thanked me, which made me think that I should take care of her more often.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like3: When I told her about the myth that you age with every bowl you empty, she asked me for ten portions to take home for Tig.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like4: The cake reminded her of Christmas. It was the biggest crisis that Monatium had faced in her memory as a hero.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like5: The sour flavor was enough to make her frown, but she did her best to pretend as if it was nothing. Take it easy, Lion.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like6: She was intrigued that with such an ordinary-looking exterior it could hide such a hero inside. I wonder what she means with hero.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like7: She popped one in her mouth and savored the sweetness happily, then asked gingerly if she could have another. I told her that I had some left over and gave her some more.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like8: She was about to sneeze when she opened the jar and the powder came flying out, but she tried hard to hold it in. Take it easy, Lion.
Food_ChefNote_Lion_Like9: Her eyes lit up at the sight of the various candies, but she suddenly started tasting them one by one in a calm manner. Was she trying to look like a grown up?

LoveLetter_Lion:
Dear Master,

Hello. I am writing to thank you. Ever since we first met, you have always been a great source of support. Of course, I am a Werebeast who can take care of herself...! But studying abroad in Monatium could feel a little... lonely. I cannot act spoiled around Diana, so I trust you understand. If any wicked villain troubles you, please call me. Then I will be the one to lend you strength!

Sincerely,
Lion
LoveCall_Lion:
Master, it is Lion!

Have any villains been bothering you lately?
If so, I would rush over and protect you.
Ah, I do not mean I hope many villains trouble you! I only wanted to see you more often... Ah! That slipped out. Please pretend you did not hear it. O-Okay?

You cook delicious food for me in the banquet hall, listen to my worries, and sometimes take me on outings... Yet I do not feel I have helped you nearly as much.
Hmm... I should work some extra shifts this month. Please wait just a little longer, Master! On payday, I will treat you to a splendid meal!

Think about what you want to eat before then. I will call again!
Affinity_Lion_EP01_001: Master, is your lower back healthy?
Affinity_Lion_EP01_003: I will massage it for you right away. Would you turn around?
Affinity_Lion_EP01_004: My back still feels perfectly light. Why?
Affinity_Lion_EP01_005: I am glad you are healthy. Chief Diana often said her lower back hurt.
Affinity_Lion_EP01_006: You are not planning to beat me mercilessly with that hammer, are you?
Affinity_Lion_EP01_007: B-beat you mercilessly?! I do not strike adults for no reason!
Affinity_Lion_EP02_001: I never knew there were foods with so many different flavors in the world. How fascinating!
Affinity_Lion_EP02_003: I often buy space rations at Monatium 25. I suppose I became accustomed to their lack of flavor without realizing it.
Affinity_Lion_EP02_004: Tell me if there is anything you want to eat. I will make it all for you.
Affinity_Lion_EP02_005: Really? Then I... want to try just this one!
Affinity_Lion_EP02_006: Is that reaction not a little exaggerated?
Affinity_Lion_EP02_007: Ah... Was I speaking too loudly? I should speak quietly in a public place. I am sorry.
Affinity_Lion_EP03_001: What do you think of white lies, Master?
Affinity_Lion_EP03_002: Lies are not allowed! They are bad!
Affinity_Lion_EP03_003: Exactly. I was taught that lies are bad too. Lying is guilty!
Affinity_Lion_EP03_004: Who is White, and why do they lie?
Affinity_Lion_EP03_005: What...? Is an ill-timed joke guilty or innocent?
Affinity_Lion_EP03_006: Sometimes a white lie is necessary.
Affinity_Lion_EP03_007: Hmm, but we must not forget that we bear full responsibility for our own lies.
Affinity_Lion_EP04_001: I like how peaceful the Banquet Hall is. Do villains ever appear here too?
Affinity_Lion_EP04_002: I threw one out today too.
Affinity_Lion_EP04_003: You drove a villain outside? Call me next time. I will pass proper judgment on them.
Affinity_Lion_EP04_005: Did you call for me, Master? Dark heroine Sphinx, reporting for duty!
Affinity_Lion_EP04_006: There are some troublesome customers, but they are rather cute.
Affinity_Lion_EP04_007: You must not keep overlooking a villain's misdeeds. They will only repent after receiving a just punishment.
Affinity_Lion_EP05_001: Are my friends in the Anti-Feed Party doing well? Do they still cause trouble these days?
Affinity_Lion_EP05_002: Yes. Did you play together as children?
Affinity_Lion_EP05_003: Yes. In our immature days... we used to run around the Beastfolk village and play together.
Affinity_Lion_EP05_005: They have not changed since childhood. It seems about time for everyone to grow up.
Affinity_Lion_EP05_006: They seem to act a little more politely toward Diana lately, perhaps?
Affinity_Lion_EP05_007: Really? Chief Diana must be very pleased!
Affinity_Lion_EP06_001: Hmm... Master? Forgive me for saying so, but the Banquet Hall does not seem very sanitary.
Affinity_Lion_EP06_003: What? You were aware of it, yet left the hygiene problem unattended? Guilty!
Affinity_Lion_EP06_004: It cannot be helped if I am to provide the Apostles with a meal.
Affinity_Lion_EP06_005: I see. I will take the circumstances into consideration this time.
Affinity_Lion_EP06_006: I have no time to clean.
Affinity_Lion_EP06_007: Is it time for heroine Sphinx to act? I shall cleanly execute the villain known as filth!
Affinity_Lion_EP07_001: I think I need to leave a little early today. My part-time shift was moved forward.
Affinity_Lion_EP07_002: What kind of part-time job did you say you had?
Affinity_Lion_EP07_003: I load and unload goods at the Monatium logistics center. It takes strength, so I find it rather fun.
Affinity_Lion_EP07_004: You make sure to eat properly, right?
Affinity_Lion_EP07_005: Of course. Master looks after my meals too. I am always grateful.
Affinity_Lion_EP07_006: Would they not forgive you for being a little late?
Affinity_Lion_EP07_007: I cannot allow that. A promised time must always be kept.
Affinity_Lion_EP08_001: Queen Erpin seems to be quietly avoiding me... What could be the reason?
Affinity_Lion_EP08_002: Did you torment her with your hammer?
Affinity_Lion_EP08_003: I object to that suggestion. I did not torment the Queen. I merely passed just judgment on her.
Affinity_Lion_EP08_005: Really? She did not seem that way... But since Master said it, I will believe you.
Affinity_Lion_EP08_006: Perhaps she is afraid of being judged by you.
Affinity_Lion_EP08_007: If she has committed no crime, she should be able to stand proudly. I will explain that carefully the next time we meet.
Affinity_Lion_EP09_001: I enjoy going to Monatium 25 these days.
Affinity_Lion_EP09_003: Yes. Xion sometimes shares discarded lunch boxes with me.
Affinity_Lion_EP09_004: How about working part-time at the convenience store?
Affinity_Lion_EP09_005: I hear many troublesome customers visit convenience stores. I would probably be fired quickly.
Affinity_Lion_EP09_006: Do you not get tired of going so often?
Affinity_Lion_EP09_007: I do not know. One does not tire of one's home simply because one returns every day.
Affinity_Lion_EP10_001: What is most important for a heroine judge?
Affinity_Lion_EP10_003: Carrying out justice against villains is heroine Sphinx's specialty.
Affinity_Lion_EP10_005: As expected... Strength is most important for delivering a clean judgment without repercussions, right? I agree with Master.
Affinity_Lion_EP10_007: Ugh... That reminds me of my shameful past. I will never compromise with villains again!
Affinity_Lion_EP11_001: You look especially tired today. Did something happen?
Affinity_Lion_EP11_002: Elphin ran away again, so I searched for her all day.
Affinity_Lion_EP11_003: Oh dear, it seems the Fairy Queen is committing crimes again. Is it time for my hammer to act once more?
Affinity_Lion_EP11_004: Tig came to the Banquet Hall and caused trouble before leaving.
Affinity_Lion_EP11_005: Hmm, after troubling Chief Diana, she has even troubled Master... I shall have to speak with her properly sometime.
Affinity_Lion_EP11_006: Order work has piled up too much lately...
Affinity_Lion_EP11_007: Ah... Th-that is something I cannot really help with. G-good luck, Master!
Affinity_Lion_EP12_001: Anonymous gifts keep arriving from someone who says they are a fan of Sphinx. Who could it be?
Affinity_Lion_EP12_002: Is there anything written on them?
Affinity_Lion_EP12_003: 'ypS a toN yletinifeD'...? Something strange like that is written here.
Affinity_Lion_EP12_004: What kind of gift is it? I want to see it too.
Affinity_Lion_EP12_005: Hmm... It is a little suspicious, but since it was sent to me, I want to open it later when I am alone!
Affinity_Lion_EP12_006: Be careful with things like that. It could be from a stalker.
Affinity_Lion_EP12_007: What? Really? If so, I shall find them without fail and pass judgment!
Affinity_Lion_EP13_001: Master, what if we used the Banquet Hall as a confessional? When someone confesses a crime, I will hide and then emerge to judge them!
Affinity_Lion_EP13_002: ...Would that not cease to be a confession?
Affinity_Lion_EP13_003: In any case, guilty villains would be judged. Would that not be a good thing?
Affinity_Lion_EP13_004: Good. Then let us begin with Lion.
Affinity_Lion_EP13_005: What? M-me? If I confess my sins... I hide, emerge, and judge myself... Hmm? Whaaat?
Affinity_Lion_EP13_006: If you do that, no one may visit the Banquet Hall anymore.
Affinity_Lion_EP13_007: Hmm... Are you saying no one is innocent enough to stand proudly? That is a serious problem...
Affinity_Lion_EP14_001: What walks on two legs in the morning and four legs in the evening?
Affinity_Lion_EP14_003: Yes! Is it not fun? Hurry and guess! The hint is this hammer!
Affinity_Lion_EP14_004: That is a little different from the version I know.
Affinity_Lion_EP14_005: What? Is there a similar riddle? I worked so hard to think of this one...
Affinity_Lion_EP14_006: I have no idea. What is the answer?
Affinity_Lion_EP14_007: The answer is a villain judged by my hammer. After one blow, they end up crawling on all fours.
Affinity_Lion_EP15_001: It seems Monatium 25 is selling some event merchandise. Xion looked extremely busy.
Affinity_Lion_EP15_002: An event? What are they doing?
Affinity_Lion_EP15_003: I do not know either. It seems the merchandise contains small stickers of some kind.
Affinity_Lion_EP15_004: How about going to help her?
Affinity_Lion_EP15_005: I helped briefly once... but a customer asked whether the merchandise had been restocked every five minutes. It was exhausting.
Affinity_Lion_EP15_006: Are you not interested in events like that?
Affinity_Lion_EP15_007: I have a duty to catch villains who disturb justice. This is not the time to be distracted.

Affinity_Lion_EP17_005: What? That will not do. Guilty, guilty!
Affinity_Lion_EP17_006: Hmm... There are too many to count.
Affinity_Lion_EP17_007: Goodness... Master, you have suffered greatly all this time. I, heroine Sphinx, shall help you...!
